description: Test a four-agent scout-and-follow task: a seed-varying distant adjacent food cluster with enough food and horizon for a discovered return trail to help other agents, while retaining the fair three-seed full/no-pheromone comparison.
selection_rule: No automatic winner. Candidate G can move to team review only when full-input PPO beats its same-seed separately trained no-pheromone PPO and random action on seeds 7, 17 and 27. This remains development work; Phase 2B does not start from a single seed.
required_reports: per-seed stochastic and deterministic food-delivery means
random-action reference on the same diagnostic maps
training/runtime provenance and every failed run
